subject: Materials Science
title: Diffusion: Atoms on the Move
description: A fast breakdown of Diffusion: Atoms on the Move for builders.

hook.text: A gold ring in contact with silver will slowly blend at the boundary — atoms migrate through solids.

buildup.text: Diffusion moves atoms through a crystal — driven by concentration gradients and aided by vacancies.

discovery.text: Fick's first law says flux equals diffusivity times concentration gradient — simple but powerful.

twist.text: Diffusion rate doubles roughly every 20°C increase — temperature is the master switch.

climax.text: Semiconductor doping drives specific atoms into silicon by diffusion — precise control of conductivity.

punchline.text: Atoms in solids never sit still — they hop, one vacancy at a time.

quiz.question: What drives atomic diffusion in a crystal?
options: Concentration gradients and thermal energy via vacancies
